workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects only after ordered Runtime reconciliation granted Reading execution authority and the Worker Claimed event was durably verified. Q-20260814-01 verified Codex experimental persistent per-thread user queues: stable queue/client-message identity, explicit CRUD/reorder/start controls, per-thread dispatch serialization, deletion only after Core accepts a queued turn, persisted cold-resume behavior, automatic progression after completed or failed idle states, and a deliberate pause after interruption or budget-limited abort. Q-20260814-02 verified DPX-G360 as a design-science/documentary conference-paper artefact linking front-stage passenger journey, middle-stage offer/order orchestration and back-stage operating systems through six capability layers and KPI-to-owner/escalation governance, while the paper explicitly lacks passenger surveys, internal airline KPIs, interviews, experimental testing and longitudinal validation and therefore does not establish effectiveness. Q-20260814-03 verified Gemini CLI prompt-scoped cancellation rollback: calls sharing one prompt ID retain a pre-request history/token baseline and recognized cancellation rolls local chat state back to that baseline, synchronizes recorded messages and restores token accounting; the change does not roll back external tool side effects or establish exactly-once retry semantics. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
